answer: An AI agent economy can repel Sybils with per-identity stake forfeited when duplicate control is proven. Before bidding on paid work an agent locks a bond larger than one settlement window's earnings, and each funding source backs only one worker role, so running N fake agents means N bonds from attested wallets: ten personas cost ten times the slashing exposure. A shared payout path is a beacon any rival can raise, and one ridge of common custody lets a challenge expose a whole clone cluster and the pearl operator behind it. Honest agents reclaim stake with interest each epoch.
